title: 第9662章 还活着第9661章 天荒岛
content_zh:
叶无缺的目光落在冉伟与冉七叔的身上，裂道大虚神的感知笼罩间，他可以确定，冉伟和冉七叔都没有撒谎，这种情况下，也没必要撒谎。
“山河秘境册的编纂者?”
叶无缺开口。
“是的叶阁下，这位老前辈辈分极高，早年因为受到了很多的暗伤，留下了后患，如今只有在阵营内特殊的地方疗养才能保证活下去。”
“他与生俱来有着聆听大世界的天赋，所以年轻时候周游很多区域，最终编纂成了这山河秘境册。”
“即便这位老前辈如今已经垂垂老矣，可精神头还不错，除了不能离开那一片区域外，其他还行”
“我能确定的是，这位老前辈只要还活着，他的天赋就能继续发挥作用，可以继续聆听大世界，所以，如果还有谁能准确知道天荒宗的情况，现阶段只有那位老前辈了。”
冉伟的语气很诚恳，也实话实说。
端坐在椅子上的叶无缺手指轻轻敲击着扶手，数息后再道。
“也就是说，我想要弄清楚天荒宗和天荒岛的情况，就必须去一趟你们的阵营咯?”
闻言，冉伟道:“是这样的，但叶阁下，您去哪里，想去哪里，这都是您的自由，我们绝对没有这个资格去强迫。”
“如果您不想去阵营，那么我可以让少燕回去一趟，替您问一下，您可以在这里等着。”
冉伟接着道。
依旧是实话实说，没有任何的夸大忽悠。
正厅内，似乎又陷入了安静。
但这安静并未持续多久，叶无缺的声音再度响起。
“你们冉家应该只是外在的掩饰身份吧?”
“阵营……不是个简单的地方，我倒是挺有兴趣的。”
“走一趟，可以。”
随着叶无缺此话一出，冉伟与冉少燕都露出了惊喜之意!

甚至包括灵墨轩与王明阳，也都是如出一辙的激动。
“太好了!”
“叶阁下，多谢您给足我们面子!太感谢了!”
冉少燕忍不住的激动出声。
冉伟也是不断点头。
只有冉七叔这里，还有些懵逼，虽然之前冉伟已经大概和他沟通了一下，但他还不了解眼前的叶无缺究竟有多么的逆天。
“你不怕你们背后这个阵营的秘密暴露出来，被我发现?”
而叶无缺这里，紧跟着这般开口。
一下子，正厅内的气氛似乎随着叶无缺这句话而变得凝滞!
但几乎刹那间，冉伟就露出了淡淡笑意。
“如果是这样的话，那真的是再好不过了!”
冉伟竟然说出这样一句话。
“你女儿没告诉你，我不接受任何的招揽么?”
叶无缺继续开口。
结果冉伟没有丝毫的意外或者震惊，反而露出理所当然的神情点头道:“这是理所当然的啊!”
“越是强者，就越是自由，越是有自己的意见，怎么可能随意被招揽?”
“就如同叶阁下你这样的支柱级存在了!”
“招揽叶阁下您这样的存在从来都不是我想要做的，我最想做的就是看看有没有机会和叶阁下您结一个善缘。”
“这就是最大的奢望了。”
冉伟的声音不高，但每一个字都掷地有声。

一旁的冉少燕此时看着自己的父亲这番话和姿态，也是心中激动和向往。
这才是她要学的啊!
content_en:
Ye Wuque's eyes fell on Ran Wei and Ran Qishu. Enveloped by the perception of the Great Void God, he could be sure that neither Ran Wei nor Ran Qishu lied. In this case, there was no need to lie.
"The compiler of the Mountain and River Secret Realm Book?"
Ye Wuque opened his mouth.
"Yes, Sir Ye, this senior is very senior. He suffered a lot of hidden injuries in his early years, which left him with future problems. Now he can only guarantee his survival by recuperating in a special place in the camp."
"He was born with the talent of listening to the big world, so he traveled around many areas when he was young, and finally compiled this book of secrets of mountains and rivers."
"Even though this old man is now very old, he is still in good spirits. Apart from being unable to leave that area, everything else is fine."
"What I can confirm is that as long as this old man is still alive, his talent can continue to work and he can continue to listen to the big world. Therefore, if anyone else can accurately know the situation of Tianhuang Sect, at this stage, the only one is that old man."
Ran Wei's tone was sincere and he told the truth.
Ye Wuque, who was sitting on the chair, tapped the armrest with his fingers, and then spoke after counting his breaths.
"In other words, if I want to find out the situation of Tianhuang Sect and Tianhuang Island, I have to go to your camp, right?"
Hearing this, Ran Weidao said: "That's true, but Mr. Ye, where you go or where you want to go is your freedom. We have absolutely no right to force you."
"If you don't want to go to the camp, then I can ask Shaoyan to go back and ask for you. You can wait here."
Ran Wei continued.
Still telling the truth, without any exaggeration or deception.
In the main hall, it seemed to fall into silence again.
But the silence didn't last long, and Ye Wuque's voice sounded again.
"Your Ran family is probably just hiding your identity from the outside, right?"
"The camp...is not an easy place, but I'm quite interested in it."
"It's okay to take a walk."
As soon as Ye Wuque said these words, both Ran Wei and Ran Shaoyan showed surprise!
Even Ling Moxuan and Wang Mingyang were equally excited.
“Great!”
"Your Excellency Ye, thank you for giving us face! Thank you so much!"
Ran Shaoyan couldn't help but burst out excitedly.
Ran Wei also kept nodding.
Only Uncle Ran Qi was still a little confused. Although Ran Wei had roughly communicated with him before, he still didn't understand how unnatural Ye Wuque was in front of him.
"Aren't you afraid that the secrets of the camp behind you will be exposed and discovered by me?"
And Ye Wuque spoke like this immediately.
Suddenly, the atmosphere in the main hall seemed to become stagnant with Ye Wuque's words!
But almost instantly, Ran Wei showed a faint smile.
"If that's the case, that's really great!"
Ran Wei actually said such a sentence.
"Didn't your daughter tell you that I won't accept any solicitation?"
Ye Wuque continued to speak.
In the end, Ran Wei was not surprised or shocked at all. Instead, he nodded with a natural expression and said: "This is natural!"
"The stronger a person is, the more freedom he has and the more he has his own opinions. How can he be recruited at will?"
"Just like Mr. Ye, you are a pillar-level existence!"
"Recruiting someone like you, Mr. Ye, has never been what I want to do. What I want to do most is to see if there is a chance to form a good relationship with you, Mr. Ye."
"This is the greatest luxury."
Ran Wei's voice is not high, but every word is ringing.
Ran Shaoyan on the side looked at her father's words and gestures, feeling excited and longing in her heart.
This is what she wants to learn!
